title: Bayesian mixture modeling using a mixture of finite mixtures with normalized inverse Gaussian weights

split.decision: Full source 50-network observed validation set; independently seeded judge-held 50-network set. Exact original generator; consistent independent node permutations hide fixed label ordering. Truth/parameters/seeds outside prediction inputs.

baseline.paper_ref: Section 4.3.1 Table 3; source reproduction dARI 0.8627841513162644, historical only; no benchmark reference measured

allowed_changes: Any valid posterior sampler, deterministic integration or approximation strategy may replace telescoping Gibbs, with editable numerical optimization and initialization.
Iteration labels preserve the output grid, not a mandatory transition implementation or burn-in schedule.
When retaining the supplied TS_IG_network_DMFM_BNB sampler, changing only s_pro=1.0, the initial k=10, iters=100000 or burn=50000 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Improve posterior community inference for the specified DMFM-IGau network model, scored by posterior-mean fossil ARI.
The Bernoulli stochastic-block likelihood and normalized inverse-Gaussian DMFM weights remain fixed, with BNB(1,4,3) on M-1, Beta(1,1) on Q and F(6,3) on shape.
Each observed 50-node network is independent; all 50000 posterior partition slots, canonical labels and k/M/M_na semantics, literal fossil ARI and aggregation remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not change weight/shape/component priors or graph likelihood, substitute generic spectral clustering for posterior inference, or fabricate a point-mass posterior by duplicating an unrelated point estimate.
No hidden communities, generator-seed reconstruction, cross-network fitting or output-slot reduction.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
